original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州两起交通事故致三人死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州萨加穆-伊科罗杜高速公路和奥塔-伊迪罗科路发生两起独立交通事故，造成三人死亡、七人受伤。奥贡州交通合规与执法机构发言人巴巴通德·阿金比伊证实了这两起事故。第一起事故发生在萨加穆-伊科罗杜高速公路卡姆钢铁路段，一名女性死亡，另有两名女性受伤。

location.site: 萨加穆-伊科罗杜高速公路卡姆钢铁路段及奥塔-伊迪罗科路阿加拉武Winners路段
location.raw_text: Sagamu-Ikorodu Expressway and the Ota–Idiroko Road in Ogun State

key_facts.fact: 奥贡州两起交通事故造成三人死亡、七人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Three persons have been killed and seven others injured in two separate road crashes along the Sagamu-Ikorodu Expressway and the Ota–Idiroko Road in Ogun State.

key_facts.fact: 事故发生在周六，分别位于卡姆钢铁路段和阿加拉武Winners路段
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the accidents occurred on Saturday at the Kam Steel axis of the Sagamu–Ikorodu Expressway and the Agarawu, Winners axis of the Ota–Idiroko Road

key_facts.fact: 奥贡州交通合规与执法机构发言人证实了事故
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The spokesperson for the Ogun State Traffic Compliance and Enforcement Agency, Babatunde Akinbiyi, confirmed the incidents in a traffic update on Saturday.

key_facts.fact: 第一起事故致一名女性死亡、两名女性受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the first accident occurred at the Kam Steel axis of the Sagamu–Ikorodu Highway, leaving a woman dead and two other women with injuries

uncertainties: 第二起事故的伤亡细节尚未在正文中披露
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
